data.name: Jawaher
data.gender_notes: Jawaher is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A precious gemstone, symbolizing beauty and elegance. The name Jawaher carries the meaning “Jewels” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jawaher usually hope their child will grow to embody jewels and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of the beauty and elegance of faith.
data.etymology: Jawaher belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Jewels.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jawaher total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: جوهير
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، مشتق من جوهر، يعني اللآلئ والشَوق والجمال. الجواهر هي الثروات الخفية التي تلمع في باطن الأرض، مما يعكس قيمة وروعة هذا الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: جواہر
in_urdu.meaning: جواہر کا مطلب ہے خوبصورتی، قیمتی چیزیں، اور دلکش
in_urdu.long_meaning: جواہر ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورتی، قیمتی چیزیں، اور دلکش۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے لئے مقبول ہے، خاص طور پر اردوگو بولنے والے ممالک میں۔ اس کا تعلق عربی جڑوں سے ہے جو ثروت، جمال، اور دلکشی کو ظاہر کرتی ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: जवाहर
in_hindi.meaning: जवाहर का अर्थ है सुंदरता, मूल्यवान वस्तुएँ, और आकर्षण
in_hindi.long_meaning: जवाहर एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है सुंदरता, मूल्यवान वस्तुएँ, और आकर्षण। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में लोकप्रिय है, खासकर हिंदी भाषी क्षेत्रों में। इसकी जड़ें अरबी भाषा में हैं जो धन, सौंदर्य, और मनोरम को दर्शाती हैं।

in_english.name: Jawaher
in_english.meaning: Jawaher means beauty, precious jewels, and attractive qualities
in_english.long_meaning: Jawaher is an Arabic-originated name that signifies beauty, precious jewels, and attractive qualities. It stems from the Arabic root 'j-w-h-r' which connotes hidden treasures or jewels. In Islamic tradition, this name symbolizes inner and outer beauty, richness, and spiritual significance. Historically, it has been used across various Muslim cultures, reflecting values of elegance and preciousness.
